meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.product: Turnover in the foreign exchange market (DBIE report 1347)
meta.coverage: How much foreign exchange changes hands in India each month: merchant (customers) and inter-bank, spot, forward, swap and cancellations, rupee and cross-currency, purchases and sales
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1347, US$ million, monthly sums of daily turnover reported by authorised dealers, since 1996. The grand total equals merchant plus inter-bank in every month but September 2018, where RBI's own table puts the grand total about US$ 28 bn (purchases) and 33 bn (sales) higher; kept as published.
